title: Add unit tests for RLSPolicyRegistry SQL generation methods
Add unit tests for PgClient app.* session variable mapping
Permission cache has no automatic invalidation on changes
description: PermissionService.cs caches SecurityProfile with 5-min TTL but invalidation is incomplete. Missing invalidation: (1) UpdateProfile() doesn't invalidate, (2) Role permission changes (GrantPermission/RevokePermission) don't invalidate user caches, (3) Direct DB commits bypass handlers. Users can operate with stale permissions for up to 5 minutes after role changes.
close_reason: Added automatic cache invalidation when: (1) user profile is updated, (2) role permissions change via GrantPermission/RevokePermission, (3) role is updated, (4) role is deleted. All 77 API tests pass.

title: Lazy service resolution in DataContext complicates debugging
description: DataContext.cs uses 6 Lazy<T> services to avoid circular dependencies. Issues: (1) Deferred init obscures real dependency problems, (2) Two services wrap already-injected params unnecessarily, (3) Stack traces include Lazy framework noise, (4) Root cause is circular dependencies - should refactor to smaller interfaces instead of masking with lazy loading.
close_reason: Removed all 6 Lazy<T> wrappers from DataContext. No circular dependencies existed - all services (AuditManager, RelationshipManager, TransactionManager, DataContextCore) have no dependency on DataContext. Also removed 3 unused constructor parameters (IServiceProvider, IPgClient, ITableManager). All 77 API tests pass.

title: Manual handler registration requires explicit DI registration
description: ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs manually registers 11 handlers (22 lines). Assembly scanning already exists in RegisterAllComponentHandlersAndQueriesFromAssembly() and is used in tests but NOT in production. Fix: Replace manual registration with one line: services.RegisterAllComponentHandlersAndQueriesFromAssembly(typeof(AuthHandler).Assembly)
close_reason: Fixed: replaced 40+ lines of manual registration with assembly scanning. API tests pass (77/77).

title: Test database schema missing Count column on test_component table
close_reason: Fixed by calling EnsureTableExists before GetExistingComponent in DataContext.Commit and TryCommit. This allows schema auto-migration to add missing columns. Fixed 43 tests (69->26 failures). Remaining 26 failures are separate issues: snapshot creation not working (CreateSnapshot is a no-op) and event emission tests.
